description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You would die.

One of your heads might be dead, but your other head can drag you back into the realm of the living through sheer force of will. You don't die. Instead, if you have the dying or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Unconscious] conditions, you lose the dying and unconscious conditions. If you're at 0 Hit Points, you have 1 Hit Point. Increase the value of your wounded condition by 1. You are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 1} and can't use any abilities that depend on two heads until you're healed to greater than half your maximum HP. You can use this reaction while unconscious, but not if your body would be destroyed, such as by the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Disintegrate] spell.
